messages:
neha: New sign-up reported quickstart-node crash: json_mode + strict schema + tool call -> validator throws 'expected object got string'.

owen: Can you share the raw response?

neha: Raw shows quoted JSON - e.g. ""{}"" or sometimes ""[]"" after a retry. Python quickstart returns {}.

claire: Sounds like our normalize/helper flow is double-stringifying on one path (likely retry/auth wrapper) or streaming assembler returns chunks that get re-stringified.

neha: Repro steps: stub tool to return 204 empty body, run quickstart-node with REDWOOD_JSON_MODE=true and REDWOOD_STRICT_SCHEMA=true, call client.call({model:'redwood-lite', tool:'meta', json_mode:true}).

owen: I can reproduce locally. Adding a quick guard in normalizeToolOutput to trim one level of outer quotes and attempt parse again. Pushing branch now.

matt: Also audit the auth-retry interceptor; I've seen code that does JSON.stringify({payload: body}) for logs in dev env which would create nested quotes if body was already a string.

claire: Short-term workaround: sample-quickstarts add a tiny post-coercion fallback that if typeof result === 'string' then try JSON.parse(result) and coerce empty -> {}. Not ideal but unblocks onboarding.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-5990: "node-sdk json_mode empty-tool-output double-stringify" (assignee: owen).

owen: Added unit tests: 204-empty-body -> {} and quoted-object handling. Also added an integration parity test that runs the node + python quickstarts with a stubbed tool and asserts outputs match.

matt: I'll open a small PR to remove stringify-on-log and switch to base64 log fields so logs don't end up in request/response bodies.

neha: After owen's patch and auth fix, verified v0.6.6 returns {} for empty-tool payload and onboarding sign-up flow is green. Thanks! :tada:

claire: Leaving follow-up DEVEX-5991 to add CI gate to sample-quickstarts that runs the parity job on PRs touching SDK helpers.

neha: Marking this thread resolved for onboarding; will monitor new sign-ups for regressions.
